text_simplified: Prayer is the second pillar of Islam after the two testimonies of faith, so parents should endear it to their daughter through encouragement, rewards, buying her a prayer mat, and accustoming her to pay attention to prayer times. Parents should also recognize individual differences and natural talents in children and direct their memorization abilities toward memorizing the Book of Allah the Exalted in Quran schools, following the example of the learned women among the daughters of the Prophet ﷺ, the Mothers of the Believers, and the female Companions (may Allah be pleased with them).
